t: The first step towards force fields is finding the base resources.$(br)MFFS components are mainly made out of $(5)Steel Ingots$(), which can be crafted in 2 simple steps. First, make yourself some $(5)Steel Compound$() in crafting, which you can then smelt into ingots.
迈向力场的第一步是寻找基础资源。$(br)MFFS组件主要由$(5)钢锭$()制成，而钢锭可通过两个简单步骤合成：首先在合成界面制作$(5)钢化合物$()，再将其冶炼成锭。
Combine an Iron Ingot with 4 Coal to create a Steel Compound.
将1个铁锭与4个煤炭合成钢化合物。
Smelting the Steel Compound into a Steel Ingot.
将钢化合物冶炼为钢锭。
One of the most common ingredients you'll be using in MFFS. It is used to craft base components such as the $(5)Focus Matrix$() or the $(2)Blank Card$(), as well as force field machinery.
你在MFFS中将频繁使用的一种基础材料。它可用于合成基础组件，例如$(5)聚焦矩阵$()或$(2)空白卡$()，也可用于制造力场机械。
